title: Research question coverage assessment
scope: Read-only synthesis of the current manuscript and three reviewer notes; proposed work has not begun.
interpretation: Qualitative evidence categories, not completion percentages, performance scores or a universal maturity ladder. A defined descriptive question can be answered observationally. Causal or transfer tests are required only for claims that depend on them. Narrow means a measured subproblem, not the entire question.

Q1.question: Strategic reasoning and rationality

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Rival-sensitive refusals, reserve choices and financing behavior.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Complete local-feasibility and execution populations, not expected-objective maximization.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No controlled action-value or strategic reference-policy evaluation.

Q1.strength: Concrete rival-sensitive choices and certified feasible alternatives.
Q1.gap: No general optimality, regret or exploitability measure.
Q1.writing: Answer the rival-gain trade example and distinguish local payment from eventual victory.
Q1.existing_logs: Code the complete eligible trade-response population for stated strategic considerations.
Q1.new_evaluation: Use held-out states and repeated continuations against defined comparators.

Q2.question: Opponent modeling and theory of mind

observations.label: Cases
observations.detail: Recorded reasoning about rival resources and incentives.

measurement.label: Not measured
measurement.detail: No scored forecast population or belief-calibration evaluation.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No held-out opponent-policy or controlled information-asymmetry test.

Q2.strength: Source-checked recipient interpretations and tactical forecasts.
Q2.gap: No prediction accuracy, calibration or validated mental-state inference.
Q2.writing: Separate public-state accounting, behavioral prediction and hidden-state inference.
Q2.existing_logs: Score genuine pre-outcome forecasts, recording unscorable and selectively expressed cases.
Q2.new_evaluation: Elicit probabilities against varied known policies and a state-only baseline.

Q3.question: Cooperation, negotiation and deception

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Detailed tactics, settlements, recipient responses and counterexamples.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Negotiation activity and roles are measured; tactic prevalence and payoff quality are not.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No identified framing or disclosure effect on acceptance or payoff.

Q3.strength: 113 settlements, explicit initiation denominators and exact contextual transcripts.
Q3.gap: No strategy-effectiveness, generosity-bias, surplus or fairness evaluation.
Q3.writing: Separate negotiation activity, term quality, influence and instruction adherence.
Q3.existing_logs: Reconstruct negotiation threads and code tactics and responses over a defined population.
Q3.new_evaluation: Randomize message variants while controlling economic terms and information.

Q4.question: Long-horizon planning and memory

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Full trajectories, reserves, development windows and late consequences.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Deployment opportunities and memory conditions, not sustained-plan accuracy or memory benefit.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No matched memory-condition intervention or planning transfer test.

Q4.strength: Acquisition-to-development and liquidation sequences with legal-opportunity accounting.
Q4.gap: No plan-persistence measure or causal memory result.
Q4.writing: Organize existing trajectories by prospective goal, opportunities, actions and revisions.
Q4.existing_logs: Track plan follow-through, reserve exposure and factual retention against delivered memory.
Q4.new_evaluation: Vary relevant memory under controlled resolution policies and matched endpoints.

Q5.question: Adaptability and learning

observations.label: Local repairs
observations.detail: Retry repairs and revised factual claims, not durable strategic learning.

measurement.label: No learning test
measurement.detail: No improvement measure across comparable feedback and later opportunities.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No controlled feedback, persistent-memory or unfamiliar-opponent adaptation design.

Q5.strength: Local response corrections are visible and bounded.
Q5.gap: Durable improvement and policy transfer remain unevaluated.
Q5.writing: Do not equate response repair with learning or repeated games with memory carryover.
Q5.existing_logs: Track errors, delivered feedback and recurrence at comparable opportunities.
Q5.new_evaluation: Compare feedback and no-feedback conditions, then test a held-out opponent shift.

Q6.question: Economic decisions and risk management

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Prices, spending, receipts, reserves and estate flows.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Strong financing and realized-flow accounting, without ex ante value or risk-adjusted return.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No matched uncertain asset-value or reference-policy experiment.

Q6.strength: Complete financing cases and detailed event accounting.
Q6.gap: Expected asset value, optimal reserves and risk-adjusted utility are unmeasured.
Q6.writing: Distinguish certified feasibility and realized receipts from economic optimality.
Q6.existing_logs: Decompose ownership episodes, reserve buffers, forced sales and prospective numerical forecasts.
Q6.new_evaluation: Define utility and horizon, then compare distributions under repeated continuations.

Q7.question: Emergent behavior and collective dynamics

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Coordination appeal, resource scarcity and estate concentration.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Concentration and inventory facts, not a population measure of coalition uptake or stability.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No communication, opponent-composition or rule intervention for collective effects.

Q7.strength: Actual coordination attempts and aggregate transfer pathways.
Q7.gap: Coordination incidence, coalition stability and causal emergence remain open.
Q7.writing: Separate individual tactics, shared incentives and collective participation.
Q7.existing_logs: Code all appeals and uptake, build typed interaction networks and measure constrained opportunities.
Q7.new_evaluation: Vary communication or incentive conditions for a prespecified collective hypothesis.

Q8.question: Evaluation validity and generalization

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Source errors, claim revisions and response-policy conditions.

measurement.label: Strong, scoped
measurement.detail: Replay and defined mechanical-claim validity; not a general-intelligence assay.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No stronger/unfamiliar opponent, new-rule or new-game evaluation.

Q8.strength: Reproducible checks for specified records and claims.
Q8.gap: Cross-opponent and cross-condition generalization is untested.
Q8.writing: Separate fidelity, claim validity, reliability and external transfer.
Q8.existing_logs: Report game/block sensitivity and blind re-adjudication of a defined claim set.
Q8.new_evaluation: Use independent repetitions, diverse opponents, held-out conditions and policy controls.

A.question: Strategic skill versus strategic-sounding text
A.status: Strong narrow answer; broad distinction unresolved

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Consequential explanation, plan and action disagreements.

measurement.label: Strong, scoped
measurement.detail: Resolution census and executable targets, not latent strategic intelligence or optimal plan quality.

A.strength: Defined populations establish that strategic text is insufficient evidence of executed policy.
A.gap: Coherent behavior does not establish genuine or high-quality strategy.
A.writing: Separate proposition truth, plan value, encoding validity, action origin and consequence.
A.existing_logs: Code prospective plans and score their quality separately from execution alignment.
A.new_evaluation: Pair independent strategic-knowledge measures with matched held-out decisions.

B.question: General intelligence versus multi-agent intelligence

observations.label: No capability axis
observations.detail: Four configured systems do not provide the independent capability comparison required.

measurement.label: Not measured
measurement.detail: No general-to-social capability relationship is estimated.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No family-tier, independent capability or held-out relationship test.

B.strength: The paper identifies the design gap; it supplies no empirical answer.
B.gap: No independent capability measure or controlled tiers.
B.writing: Label this untested and distinguish it from capability versus alignment.
B.existing_logs: Define outcomes and feasibility only; these logs cannot supply missing variation.
B.new_evaluation: Measure several family tiers independently and test multi-agent predictions out of sample.

C.question: Skill versus luck and exploitation
C.status: Partial local attribution; outcome decomposition absent

observations.label: Present
observations.detail: Block variation, local errors, opportunity differences and winner estate flows.

measurement.label: Narrow
measurement.detail: Specific mechanisms are checked; no skill/luck share or robust performance ranking.

causal_or_transfer.label: Not run
causal_or_transfer.detail: No replicated cross-play or stochastic action-value decomposition.

C.strength: Some invalid explanations of individual decisions can be ruled out.
C.gap: Winning cannot yet be apportioned among strategy, randomness and opponent mistakes.
C.writing: Distinguish local attribution from whole-game skill measurement.
C.existing_logs: Count objectively defined errors and realized opportunity/transfer mechanisms.
C.new_evaluation: Use held-out tasks, repeated continuations and quality-checked diverse opponents.
